scripts.build:prod: webpack --config webpack.config.cjs --mode production && node scripts/assert-production-bundle.mjs && node scripts/smoke-esm-modules.mjs
scripts.zip: if [ -f dist/.store-build ]; then echo 'dist/ holds a store build — run `pnpm run build` before `pnpm run zip`' >&2; exit 1; fi && rm -f knoww-extension.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../knoww-extension.zip . -x '.*' '.stats/*' '*.LICENSE.txt'
scripts.zip:store: if [ ! -f dist/.store-build ]; then echo 'dist/ is not a verified store build — run `pnpm run build:store` before `pnpm run zip:store`' >&2; exit 1; fi && rm -f knoww-extension-store.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../knoww-extension-store.zip . -x '.*' '.stats/*' '*.LICENSE.txt'
scripts.release: node scripts/bump-version.mjs && pnpm run build && pnpm run zip
scripts.release:store: node scripts/bump-version.mjs && pnpm run build:store && pnpm run zip:store
